# netactuate_cloud_ipv4_reverse_dns (Resource)

Manages a Cloud IPv4 Reverse DNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_cloud_ipv4_reverse_dns" "example" {
  address_id = 12345
  mbpkgid    = 12345
  reverse    = "host.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address_id` (Number) IPv4 address ID.
- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID that owns the IPv4 address.
- `reverse` (String) IPv4 reverse DNS value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_cloud_ipv4_reverse_dns.example 12345
```
